body.intent: Every read goes through one projection interface behind workspace, whose only implementation is the index with dry-run pending entries laid over it: status and its hook, the inbox, render, change ls and the daemon fold stop folding the whole log, and workspace reads the log at most once per call. Evidence: status.go:123, render.go:99, change.go:669, inbox.go:619 and daemon_fold.go:197 call changeset.FoldLog; inboxGateRead clears IndexPath; workspace.log() rereads the disk on every call; status 2.0 s and inbox 2.3 s on this repo.
body.title: Reads from the projection
